gloss: generational change; changing of the guard

definitions.gloss: generational change; generation shift; changing of the guard
definitions.explanation: The process of an older generation being replaced by a younger one in leadership, influence, or prominence. Used in business, politics, sports, and biology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The generational change at the company is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦{界|かい}→界：09651_kai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ている→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A wave of generational change is coming in the sports world too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that generational change in the world of politics is slow to progress.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧ (generation) and ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧ (replacement/change). Widely used in discussions about business succession, political leadership transitions, sports team renewal, and even biological evolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: generational change progresses
- {世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time for a generational change
- {世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to plan for generational renewal
- {世代|せだい}{交代|こうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧: a wave of generational change

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代替|だいたい}わり: change of generation — more personal, often for family succession
- ⟦{新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}→新陳代謝：11093_shinchintaisha⟧: metabolism — used figuratively for organizational renewal
- ⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: replacement, turnover — the general act of replacing, not specifically generational
